# axm logout

Remove saved registry credentials.

## When to use

Use this when ending a local authenticated session.

## Usage

```bash
axm logout [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](global-flags).

## Examples

**Sign out of the current registry**

```bash
axm auth logout
```

**Same command via shortcut**

```bash
axm logout
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

- writesFiles
